newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials seen moving higher at opening.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials seen moving higher at opening.

text.p: The Dow Industrials are expected to move higher in early trading, following through on a late attempt on Wednesday to recoup losses after being pounded by a sell-off in IBM Corp shares.
Analysts said PepsiCo Inc would rally strongly on press reports that it was on the verge of spinning off its $11 billion restaurant business, fuelling blue chips.
"If you look at yesterday, you see that when we ended we were coming back. The breadth was even kiel," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities.
"I think we'll have some momentum at the opening left over from late yesterday, and after that it will be a matter of earnings and all the usual stuff."
He said that markets would be watching the U.S. Treasury auction of $12.5 billion in five-year notes after a less than spectacular two-year note auction on Wednesday.
